arguments.text: 6 km, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: fastest finish. Plan: settle after the hard start to about critical power on the pod (CP shaft ~196 W, sustainable ~200 W), keep even effort, spend the reserve over the last 600-800 m (finish cue near 700 m to go). Watch for: drag/weed (push_local drop with steady pod power), pod drift (pod power vs heart rate / boat power mismatch), CP mis-calibration (heart rate keeps climbing at steady effort = CP too high), radio messages (course length). Test pieces only if a belief is uncertain enough to change the pacing.

~10 min (race_s ~600): CP experiment started. Piece: 150 s at -8% (~188 W) then 150 s at +6% (~216 W) from 204 W base. Read HR slope in the last ~90 s of each segment (about [660,750] and [810,900] - check actual start in cue log). HR slope proportional to (P - CP): zero crossing gives CP.
